title: That Should Not Be: Our Children Will Accuse Us

infobox.Release dates: 15 October 2008 (2008-10-15) (Montréal International Festival of New Cinema and New Media))

release_dates: 15 October 2008 (2008-10-15) (Montréal International Festival of New Cinema and New Media))

text.lead:
That Should Not Be: Our Children Will Accuse Us (Original title: Nos enfants nous accuseront, US title: Food Beware: The French Organic Revolution) is a 2008 French documentary film directed by Jean-Paul Jaud.
The documentary is about food poisoning by toxins from agricultural chemicals such as pesticides, herbicides, fertilizers, etc.
text.plot: The film tells the story of an initiative in Barjac, a commune located in the Gard department in southern France, that decided to introduce organic produce into the town's school cafeteria.
